name: Doro Wat
description: Slow-cooked tender chicken leg in rich berbere spice sauce with hard-boiled egg and injera.

name: Shiro Tegabeno
description: Richly spiced chickpea and yellow split pea flour stew served piping hot in a traditional clay pot.

name: Special Kitfo
description: Minced lean beef seasoned with niter kibbeh (clarified butter) and mitmita spice, served with ayib cheese and gomen.

name: Yebessar Beyaynetu
description: Colorful vegetarian platter featuring shiro, kik alicha, misir wat, gomen, and beet salad on fresh injera.

name: Beef Shekla Tibs
description: Sizzling strips of tender beef sauteed with onions, rosemary, and jalapeno peppers on a clay burner.

name: Special Chechebsa
description: Shredded flatbread (kitcha) tossed in berbere and warm spiced clarified butter, topped with honey and fresh yogurt.

name: Fasika Gomen besiga
description: Fresh collard greens simmered with tender beef chunks, garlic, ginger, and spiced butter.

name: Asa Tibs (Fish)
description: Crispy fried lake fish nuggets seasoned with korarima spice and served with spicy dipping sauce.

name: Layered Avocado Spris
description: Freshly blended layered smoothie with mango, papaya, and cream avocado topped with vimto drizzle.

name: Traditional Spiced Macchiato
description: Double shot of rich Ethiopian Yirgacheffe espresso layered with silky steamed milk foam.

name: Ambo Mineral Water (500ml)
description: Naturally sparkling mineral water from the thermal springs of Ambo.

name: Tej Honey Wine (Glass)
description: Authentic fermented Ethiopian honey wine brewed with gesho leaves.
